notes: Access: Akamai Bot Manager JS interstitial solved via curl_cffi chrome impersonation (POST /_sec/verify?provider=interstitial with the page's own bm-verify token + computed pow), same route as the prior Furniture pass for this company (see notes/21.md); no proxy needed. Checked: main nav (19 top-level items, en-AE at /ae/ and ar-AE at /ae/ar/ - both confirmed via hreflang tags in the homepage head), footer nav (same set of links as main nav plus Help/Newsletter/Contact/Stores/Careers/Search), the homepage's embedded serverApp-state JSON, the site's own sitemap (robots.txt Sitemap: entry -> sitemap-index-home-categories-zh.xml -> sitemap-home-categories-zh-ae-0.xml.gz, 592 category URLs for this exact AE store, grepped for best/bestseller/top-seller/popular/trending/customer-favorite terms - zero matches), and direct URL guesses (/ae/best-sellers, /ae/bestsellers, /ae/best-selling, /ae/top-sellers, /ae/popular, /ae/customer-favorites) - every one of these returns HTTP 200 but is the site's own soft-404 template (title 'Error Page | Zara Home UAE'), i.e. not a real page. The homepage/category serverApp-state DOES contain internal CMS grid modules literally named 'BESTSELLERS' (keys like E-I-A_S_BESTSELLERS_GRID, E-I-A_M_BESTSELLERS_COMEDOR, E-I-A_F_BESTSELLERS_COSMETICA, E-I-A_S_BESTSELLERS_SALON) but each is a merchandising carousel content block (type:'grid', a UUID content id) embedded inside an ordinary category page - its own seo.keyword/seoId resolves to the SAME generic category URL as the parent page it sits on (e.g. the widget on the Home Decor page has seo.keyword='home-decor', seoId=989 - identical to the plain 'HOME DECOR' nav link, https://www.zarahome.com/ae/home-decor-mirrors-living-room-n993). These are homepage/category-page carousel widgets showcasing bestselling items within a normal category grid, not their own distinct Bestsellers listing or URL. No genuine standalone Bestsellers/Top-Sellers/Popular-Products PLP exists on this AE storefront.
